test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Heart and soul
solution:
The correct answer is: **Completely**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'heart and soul'** means to do something with complete dedication and enthusiasm.
 
• Option 3) Completely is the correct meaning as it accurately conveys the sense of the idiom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) **Quickly** means to do something at a fast pace, which is not the intended meaning of the idiom. 
 
• Option 2) **Suddenly** means to do something unexpectedly or without warning, which is not the intended meaning of the idiom. 
 
• Option 4) **Loudly** means to do something with a loud sound or voice, which is not the intended meaning of the idiom.
